integrity: Proof is self-contained for the infinite-graph family; reproducible numerical and symbolic checks supplement rather than replace the proof. A mathematical priority search is not an exhaustive uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric, nonnegative, stochastic, irreducible walks with the uniform stationary distribution; asymptotic comparison is against maximum-degree weighting and not fastest-SLEM design; no independently audited priority claim.
title: Kemeny-optimal walks on gear graphs: a four-spoke saturation threshold and a square-root baseline gap
